title: Capitals of Asia
intro: Pick the capital city of each country in Asia.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Bahrain?
questions.explain: Manama is the capital of Bahrain.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Pakistan?
questions.explain: Islamabad is the capital of Pakistan.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of India?
questions.explain: New Delhi is the capital of India.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Kazakhstan?
questions.explain: Nur-Sultan is the capital of Kazakhstan.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Brunei Darussalam?
questions.explain: Bandar Seri Begawan is the capital of Brunei Darussalam.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Jordan?
questions.explain: Amman is the capital of Jordan.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Azerbaijan?
questions.explain: Baku is the capital of Azerbaijan.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Afghanistan?
questions.explain: Kabul is the capital of Afghanistan.
